assets.subject: half-height stable stall front gate
assets.detail: ONLY the swinging gate leaf of a horse stall, as if lifted off its hinges: a half-height wooden gate about 5 ft wide and 4.5 ft tall, vertical planks, a top rail, an iron latch and strap hinges. Its left and right edges are the plank ends themselves: NO posts, NO jambs, NO frame, NO uprights taller than the gate. Standing upright, seen from the front at a slight angle. NO floor, NO walls, NO horse, NO hay.

assets.subject: long stable stall partition
assets.detail: A long, low wooden stall partition about 10 ft long and 5 ft tall seen from its broad side: thick horizontal planks on the lower two-thirds, a row of vertical iron bars above, a timber post at each end. One straight panel. Standing upright, seen from the front at a slight angle. Nothing else in the image: NO floor, NO ground, NO walls around it, NO horse, NO hay.

assets.subject: wall-mounted wooden manger
assets.detail: A wooden hay manger meant to hang on a stable wall: a slatted V-shaped hay rack above a small plank feed trough, about 4 ft wide and 3 ft tall, empty. Standing upright, seen from the front at a slight angle. Nothing else in the image: NO floor, NO ground, NO walls around it, NO horse, NO hay.
